ItemName_ZombieCure.ThankYouLetter: Thank You Letter From Zombie Survival Magazine
Tooltip_thankYouLetter: Thank you for your significant donation to the Zombie Survival Magazine, and as promised we have produced a cure based on what lead scientists believe would be the actual zombie virus. Take in the event of an emergency encounter with a zombie.
Tooltip_zombieCure: This will cure you of a zombie infection... or so it appears.
Tooltip_zombieGone: This will suppress your zombie infection... better not run out.
